gatewayClassName.description: GatewayClass for this tenant's Gateway, set from `tenant.spec.gatewayClass`. Empty means the platform default (`_cluster.gateway-class-name`, itself defaulting to the bundled `cilium` class). Whether the class terminates TLS itself or at its provider's edge comes from the platform's `gateway.edgeTerminatedClasses`, so the two cannot get out of step.

tlsPassthroughServices.description: Platform services (from publishing.exposedServices) that present a certificate of their own. Read only on the publishing tenant's Gateway and only for services the platform exposes. With `gateway.passthroughMode: separateAddress` each one gets a tls-<name> TLS-passthrough listener on port 443 of a second Gateway; with `singleAddress` the `api` entry is passed through on port 6443 of the main Gateway and the others are terminated by HTTPRoutes their own charts render. Ignored when this tenant's Gateway is on a class the platform lists in `gateway.edgeTerminatedClasses`: an HTTP-only edge cannot carry a TLS listener, so those services are not published through the tenant Gateway at all.
